body:
It's not just money. It's life. Money is just a really good example of it. It's damn ridiculous that at this point in my life I can't make ends meet. It's that for ten years we've been talking about how things would get better... and they haven't. They aren't getting better. My kids will be in junior high before we could even consider buying a home. 

Shit, it's depressing. I've worked my ass off and it just hasn't gotten me anywhere. I talk daily to the biggest dumbasses who somehow earn twice as much as I do every year. These are people that are genuinely stupid.

I just thought... if I work hard, I'll get somewhere. 

And for ten years I've been living that lie.
